app.go:9:3: a job footprint sets CPU, Memory and Timeout only — executions are tasks, not serving instances, so there is no concurrency, no scaling, no idle CPU to throttle, no cold start to boost and no in-flight requests to drain; WithParallel sets the fan-out and WithRetries the attempts (tako/footprint)
app.go:11:3: a singleton footprint sets CPU, Memory, Timeout and Drain only — min=1 and concurrency=1 are what keep the loop's host alive and alone (tako/footprint)
